VOID by TÂCHES - v1.0.0 (Windows)

A sample-based wave-warp synthesizer: load a sample, play it at pitch,
and bend it through 60 warp modes, an A/B morphing waveshaper, 34 filter
types, granular playback and a drag-and-drop modulation matrix.

This installs the VOID VST3 plugin (and optionally the standalone app).
After installation, rescan plugins in your DAW.

Requirements: Windows 10/11 64-bit, a VST3 host, and the Microsoft
WebView2 runtime (preinstalled on Windows 11 and current Windows 10;
otherwise: https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/).

Quick start: load a sample by dragging it onto the waveform, raise the
WARP or SHAPER MIX knob to bring each stage in (both ship at 0% = clean
sampler), and double-click the waveform to reset the zoom view.
